summary: Civil dispute mischaracterized as criminal case; breach of contract insufficient for cheating charges without initial fraudulent intent; prior civil remedies unexhausted; repeated complaints with escalating allegations after consigned-to-record decisions; timing discrepancy - FIR filed years after sale deed deadline; quashing warranted to prevent abuse of process.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order dismissing quashing petition set aside; FIR and all related proceedings quashed.
